articles.title: Humanity's $36 million exploit tied to compromised laptop hosting a 'multisig' wallet
articles.snippet: The compromised laptop held enough multisig keys to take over the project's bridges on two chains, a basic security failure for a startup backed by Pantera and Jump Crypto.

articles.title: Humanity Protocol token crashes more than 80% after a $32 million private-key hack
articles.snippet: The decentralized identity project said attackers compromised the keys of a foundation member and are dumping the stolen H tokens for ether.

articles.title: Influential research firm that caused AI stock meltdown lays out Hyperliquid as 'compelling' idea
articles.snippet: Unlike most crypto, Hyperliquid actually generates cash flow and has a token buyback mechanism, says Citrini Research

articles.title: Blockchain researchers warn HTX sanctions may blur crypto risk signals
articles.snippet: Researchers say broad HTX tainting could freeze legitimate users and make compliance tools less useful for tracing illicit funds.

articles.title: Privacy push as StarkWare and Sui move toward compliance-ready confidential transfers
articles.snippet: StarkWare and Sui roll out confidential transfer systems as Zama boosts compliance efforts and Zcash’s Orchard bug highlights risks in shielded privacy models.
